title: Head Hunt
ruleText: Receive 1 VP (to the max of 3 VP) for every Deathblow you perform against enemy models.

title: Open Aggression
ruleText: Reveal this Scheme during your Strategic Phase and discard it during the End Phase; receive 1 VP for every Wound you deal to enemy models this turn (to the max of 3 VP).

title: Engetsu Formation
ruleText: Receive 1 VP (to the max of 3 VP) for each party member in your Deployment Zone at the end of the game.
